flora: Stunted Araucaria (wind-swept, growing from cliff crevices in the background)
Giant Ginkgoites (with fan leaves showing bright amber autumn colors)
Cycadeoidea (Bennettitales) with visible flower-like reproductive cones in the midground
Thick mats of liverworts and mosses draped over dark volcanic rocks
Coastal Thalassotaenia (Seagrass) visible in the turquoise shallows at the bottom edge
Vertical Giant Horsetails (Equisetites) framing the sides like prehistoric reeds
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on coastal/island airiness; very high visual density; tactile leaf textures from waxy to fuzzy.

visual_logic.composition: A high-altitude, multi-layered perspective. The background features white limestone cliffs and a distant caldera volcano. The mid-ground shows a lush island floodplain. The foreground is a rocky tide-pool area. Centered at the bottom is the text 'PTERO FLORA!' in bright electric blue, 3D mixed-case letters with a heavy white bevel and glossy finish.
visual_logic.ground: A mix of white limestone sands, dark volcanic ash deposits, and clear shallow water showing seagrass.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, cool-toned morning light reflecting off the water, creating a crisp 'pop' for the blue text and highlighting the waxy cuticles of the leaves.
